conditions: April 13th, 2026—The radical, rollercoaster ski season of 2025/26 has come to an end here in Jackson Hole. We'd like to give a huge thanks to everyone who joined us during our 60th year of Teton adventuring in the snow and sun. We look forward to seeing you again soon. And if you didn't get to visit this time, start planning now because season 61 is gonna be even more fun. The Aerial Tram will reopen for summer sightseeing on May 16th, with the gondolas joining in on June 6th. Finally, more family-friendly fun and adrenalized alpine action return on June 13th with the opening of our bike park, ropes course, via ferrata, and so much more. Have a fantastic 'tweener season and get stoked for a sensational summer! -Lege
